About this offline walkthrough

Everything needed for the interactive clinical demo is inside this HTML file. Share the file, then download and double-click it in a desktop browser—not an email or file-sharing preview.

Using the walkthrough

Start with Guided, with explanations. Show me points to the next control. Fill example and field-level Use example enter editable simulated answers. Saving, consent, activation and clinician sign-off always require your explicit action.

With guidance on, Previous action revisits an instruction on the current screen; Return to current action resumes. Previous stage / Next stage move between screens while retaining drafts and saved work. Navigation never undoes activation, reopens closed evidence or repeats clinician sign-off.

Guidance and annotations can be switched independently without losing your progress. Use the EyeTrustAI logo to return to the experience chooser. Returning to the chooser, opening a prepared checkpoint or refreshing starts a new session. Progress is not saved between sessions.

What is simulated

Linden Clinical, its six encounters, scores, completed evidence cohorts and policy results are fictional. This is an interactive product-design demonstration, not clinical validation or a live integration.

The proposed module checks medication/allergy documentation fidelity against the supplied transcript. It does not establish clinical truth, assess treatment appropriateness, diagnose disease, or guarantee an individual note. Both routine and enhanced review paths retain clinician review and explicit sign-off.

Privacy and connectivity

No patient data, credentials, microphone capture, inference, API calls, emails, support delivery or EHR writes are used. Entries stay in this session; do not enter real patient information. The demo makes no network requests. Optional vendor-reference links require internet and open only when you choose to visit them.

This file contains only the clinical walkthrough. The separate social-listening walkthrough is not included.
